applicable_to: Employees who interact with potential victims
required_topics: Identification of signs and indicators of human trafficking
Understanding legal protections available for victims of human trafficking
Procedures for reporting suspected human trafficking activities
How to provide assistance, such as directing individuals to appropriate resources
recordkeeping_requirements: Maintain records of the training provided
Documentation of the date, type of training, and number of employees trained
risks_or_constraints: Non-compliance with the training requirement is subject to penalties
notes: Employers who have provided this training on or before January 1, 2019, do not need to provide additional training.
